# dsh-popNotify
**Know the moment a DeepSeek Harness session finishes — system notification, in-app toast, or a chim
ow the moment a DeepSeek Harness session finishes — system notification, in-app toast, or a chime.**
中文说明 · Install · Features · Settings · Architecture · Development

Long agent runs only need your attention when they are done. This plugin adds a bell entry to the
De

epSeek Harness sidebar, watches every session’s run status, and reminds you through the channels
you
enable — a system notification, an in-app card, a short chime, or all three.
## Features
| | Feature | What it does |
| 🔔 | **Sidebar entry** | Adds a **Session reminders** bell to the sidebar. An unread dot appears wh

en a reminder fired while the panel was closed. |
| 🖥️ | **System notification** | Desktop notificat
ion with the session title; clicking it opens that session (and focuses the window). One notificatio

n tag per session, so a session never stacks duplicates. |
| 💬 | **In-app toast** | A compact card t
hat jumps straight to the finished session when clicked. Up to 4 stack at once; each hides after 9 s

econds. |
| 🎵 | **Chime** | Two short tones (880 Hz → 1318.51 Hz) after a completion, with adjustabl

e volume. |
| 🎯 | **Draggable placement** | Drag the live toast, or the preview inside the settings
panel, to pick where reminders appear. The position is stored as a viewport ratio, so it survives wi

ndow resizes. |
| 🧭 | **Quiet by default** | The session you are currently reading never reminds you

. Subagent sessions and empty sessions are ignored. |
| 🗂️ | **Recent completions** | Keeps the last
24 completed sessions in the panel; click one to reopen it. |

### Plugin metadata

`package.json` declares an `icon` and the package ships `locale/en.json` + `locale/zh.json`, so
Deep

Seek Harness lists it as **Session Notifier / 会话提醒** with the bell icon instead of the raw
package n
ame. `screenshots.json` points the plugin market at the images in `docs/images/`.
Published on npm as `dsh-popnotify`; this repository stays the source of truth.
## Usage

1. Open **Session reminders** in the sidebar.
2. Turn on the channels you want: system notification,

in-app toast, chime.
3. Approve the notification permission when prompted — the **Request permissio

n** button lives in the panel.
4. Run a session, switch away, and wait for it to finish.
### Settings
| Setting | Default | Notes |

| System notification | on | Needs notification permission; clicking opens the session. |
| In-app t

oast | on | The overlay card inside the app window. |
| Chime | on | Played through Web Audio; the f

irst user gesture unlocks playback. |
| Volume | 60% | Applies to the chime only. |
| Toast position

| bottom-right | Stored as `{ x, y }` viewport ratios; dragged with the mouse. |
| Only when unfocu

sed | off | Skips reminders while the window has focus. |
| Ignore subagent sessions | on | Subagent
sessions finish often; keep them silent unless you disable this. |

Settings live in `localStorage` under `dsh-popnotify/settings/v1`. The welcome toast is
shown once p
er install (`dsh-popnotify/welcomed/v1`).
### When a reminder fires
A session counts as complete when `uiSession.sessionStatus` flips `running` from `true` to `false`,
or when `completionUnread` becomes `true`. The reminder is then filtered:

- the session is blank (no messages yet) → skipped;
- the session is open in the main view right now

→ skipped;

## Architecture notes
The package has two halves:
| File | Role |
| `package.json` | Declares the bundle patch (`dsh.bundle.patch`) and the browser entry (`dsh.client

`). |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the bundle into the loader graph. |
| `lib/index.js` | Host hal

f — intentionally empty; it keeps the loader entry addressable. |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half —

a hand-written `__ModuleLoader__` bundle built on React and the client slot API. |
| `locale/{en,zh

}.json` | Display title and description shown in the plugin list, per language. |
| `assets/icon.png

` | 512×512 bell icon, declared by `icon` in `package.json` (≤ 256 KiB). |
| `screenshots.json` | St
orefront screenshots for the plugin market. |
The browser half registers three slots:
| Slot | Content |

| `sidebar.panellist` | The bell entry (its id doubles as the panel key). |
| `main` | The **Session

reminders** settings panel. |
| `shell.overlay` | The toast overlay; its position comes from `toast

ers** settings panel. |
| `shell.overlay` | The toast overlay; its position comes from `toastPos`. |

At runtime `apply()` declares `[ "slots", "uiSession" ]` in `exports.inject`, so the plugin only
act
ivates when both services are available.
## Compatibility

- **DeepSeek Harness ≥ 0.2.0**; the bundle targets the `web` client platform.
- Panel UI strings are
currently **Chinese only**; the plugin's display name and description are localized through `locale

/en.json` and `locale/zh.json`.
- System notifications follow the host’s permission model (Chromium

notification API on desktop).
- Browsers require a user gesture before audio playback; the plugin un

locks the audio context on
the first click or key press.
- The desktop app has no bundle hot-reload:
restart it after installing or upgrading the plugin.
